title: filer: redirectOnRead flag in values.yaml not defined
body:
What we wanted to do: We want Trino to read from the S3 gateway but the filer to redirect to all volume nodes and not route traffic through the filer.
Flag in values.yaml: https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/blob/e030530aabe36bb01503cee1cc64b159d8819797/k8s/charts/seaweedfs/values.yaml#L595
Result: Setting `redirectOnRead` to true yields the following error message from the filer pod(fails to start):

```bash
user@machine ~/p/talos> kubectl logs seaweedfs-filer-0  -n seaweedfs                                           2
I0904 08:30:18.871018 config.go:53 Reading : Config File "security" Not Found in "[/data /root/.seaweedfs /usr/local/etc/seaweedfs /etc/seaweedfs]"
flag provided but not defined: -redirectOnRead
Example: weed filer -port=8888 -master=<ip:port>[,<ip:port>]*

Description:
  start a file server which accepts REST operation for any files.

        //create or overwrite the file, the directories /path/to will be automatically created

        //create or overwrite the file, the filename in the multipart request will be used
        POST /path/to/

        GET /path/to/

        The configuration file "filer.toml" is read from ".", "$HOME/.seaweedfs/", "/usr/local/etc/seaweedfs/", or "/etc/seaweedfs/", in that order.
```

Is the flag not used anymore? how can we achieve this in another way?

Seaweed version: chrislusf/seaweedfs:3.93
K8s version: v1.33.3
Installed via: `helm install --values=seaweedfs/values.yaml seaweedfs seaweedfs/seaweedfs --namespace seaweedfs`
